entities.label: Timeframe
entities.summary: The Contemporary era, spanning from approximately 1945 CE to 2030 CE, represents a pivotal and dynamic period in human history, fundamentally shaped by the aftermath of World War II. This timeframe, classified under the Annals of the World's Dewey-style system (division 960), is characterized by unprecedented technological acceleration, rapid globalization, and complex geopolitical shifts. It marks a departure from earlier epochs, grappling with both the promises and perils of an increasingly interconnected world, where local events often have global repercussions and advancements redefine the very fabric of society.
